title: Mappy (Talent Map) | Grok Bot Templates | Somi
description: Create a talent map of people currently working at Company. This is company mapping, not a candidate search. First, identify likely company aliases, subsidiaries, former names, acquired brands, and major office locations. Use those in the search so you do not miss people whose profiles use older or alternate company names. Map people across Functions. Organize the results by function, seniority...
